item.title: Road subsidised outside school entrance in Faraday Road, 12th October
item.description:
The carriageway between 59 and 69 Faraday Road, Welling has been sinking for somewhere. Every time a fix/repair us effected it lasts only a short while before it si ks again. The was laid about 100 years ago and consisted of steel reinforced concrete slabs. The steel reinforcement has probably rusted away and it can't take the weight of the volume of traffic generated by the school each day in termtime. Can a long term fix be done at this location please?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Faraday Road, Welling, Greater London
